subject: Evaluation timeline, success metrics, and prompt ownership
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthspan.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation timeline, success metrics, and prompt ownership

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation window and make sure teams are lined up: 

What we heard from your side
- Primary goal: reduce triage time on patient notes and improve classification precision for the claims intake pipeline (target: 15% reduction in manual review).
- Success metrics: precision@top1 for claim-type classification, latency under 200ms for in-line API calls, and end-to-end reduction in manual touches.
- Stakeholders: you (ML lead), Naveen (infra), and procurement for legal/terms.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (45–60 min):
- Option A: Tue, Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Wed, Oct 8, 14:00–14:45 PT

What we want to cover in the kickoff
1) Confirm success metrics, evaluation scope, and acceptance criteria (who signs off on success)
2) Walk through trial plan: test dataset slices, volume estimates, expected traffic pattern, and SLOs
3) Prompt set & evals: ownership of prompt pack, initial metrics to collect, and the cadence for prompt iterations
4) Security/compliance lift: who will own SOC2 evidence and IP/data boundaries

Prework (we can help):
- Please share a representative sample of the notes you want the model to operate on (PII redacted) and the 3–5 core categories you need classified.
- Identify internal reviewer(s) who will sign off on the success metrics during the trial.

I attached an evaluation charter template and a short prompt-collection checklist to speed things up. If you can confirm the preferred kickoff slot (A or B) and the list of attendees, I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: evaluation-charter-template.pdf, prompt-collection-checklist.xlsx

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthspan.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naveen Rao <naveen@healthspan.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline, success metrics, and prompt ownership

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear recap. Option B (Wed, Oct 8, 14:00–14:45 PT) works best for us — Naveen and I can make that. Can you include our security contact (I’ll confirm name tomorrow) since we’ll likely have a few SOC2 questions up front?

Quick answers to your prework ask:
- We can share a small redacted sample (10–20 notes) by EOD Tue.
- Reviewers: I’m the primary reviewer for model outputs; Naveen will own infra/perf sign-off. Procurement will need to be looped for contract terms once we validate fit.

One question: do you recommend we run the initial prompts on a sandbox instance or just via hosted API during the trial? We’re trying to minimize engineering lift.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of ML | HealthSpan Analytics
samantha.ortiz@healthspan.ai

On Mon, Sep 22, 2025 at 3:03 PM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation window and make sure teams are lined up: ...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthspan.ai>, Naveen Rao <naveen@healthspan.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline, success metrics, and prompt ownership

Perfect — booked: Wed, Oct 8, 14:00–14:45 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite momentarily with a short agenda.

Answers to your sandbox question:
- Recommendation: start with hosted API in a sandbox project we create for you (no infra changes required). This lets us iterate on prompts quickly and collect eval metrics. If you want full isolation/throughput testing later, we can stand up a private deployment for the Dedicated trial.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ve attached the evaluation charter and prompt checklist (same as earlier).
- Monica (CS) will run a brief pre-kickoff prompt-handoff workshop — she’ll reach out with a 30-min slot to collect the initial prompt pack and labeling instructions.
- Ben (solutions engineer) will prepare a short demo of how we’ll surface precision/latency metrics in the Console.

Samantha/Naveen: please confirm the security contact name and whether procurement should join the kickoff or wait until after a trial review. Once you confirm, I’ll include procurement on the invite if needed.

Agenda for Oct 8 (draft)
- 0–10m: Introductions & evaluation goals
- 10–25m: Trial plan (data, traffic, SLOs)
- 25–40m: Prompt-pack handoff & eval metrics
- 40–45m: Security/compliance next steps and owners

Link to trial folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleEvalFolder
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HS-2025-042

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marcus

Attachments: evaluation-charter-template.pdf, prompt-collection-checklist.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthspan.ai>, Naveen Rao <naveen@healthspan.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 20:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline, success metrics, and prompt ownership (pre-kickoff prework)

Thanks for looping me in — I’ll own the prompt-collection session. Quick pre-kickoff checklist I’ll send to Samantha before the workshop: 
- 1) Sample export (10–20 records) + column definitions and expected labels
- 2) One-line label definitions and a small gold-set (5–10 examples) for initial eval
- 3) Contact for security evidence (SOC2) so I can route any questions to compliance

I’ll propose two 30-minute slots (Wed, Oct 1 — morning PT, or Thu, Oct 2 — afternoon PT) for the handoff. If procurement needs to be on the kickoff, we should plan to include them only for the closing 10 minutes.

I’ll follow up with the calendar invites and a short worksheet for the prompt pack.

—Monica
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
